outgoing.name: Capital
outgoing.excerpt: The District of Yamoussoukro is the official capital city of Côte d'Ivoire.

outgoing.name: Concorde
outgoing.excerpt: …the only airport in Africa that can accommodate the Concorde), the Town Hall, the Protestant Temple, the Mosque,…

outgoing.name: Pope John Paul II
outgoing.excerpt: …of Our Lady of Peace of Yamoussoukro, consecrated by Pope John Paul II on September 10, 1990.
